title: Manage your web apps from one page
body: chrome://apps now lists every web app you've installed — launch or uninstall them right from the grid, no digging through Settings required.

title: Send feedback in a couple clicks
body: The new Feedback page sends your report straight to us along with the page you were on and your browser version — no account or sign-in needed.

title: Shared page notes are now account-secured
body: Notes you share on a page are now tied to your signed-in Google or Microsoft account, so only people you've actually shared with can add or remove them.

title: Automatic cleanup for forgotten tabs
body: Turn on auto-archive in Settings → Performance and background tabs you haven't touched in days get freed from memory automatically — they're still right there when you click back.
